error_types.name: Missing Colon
error_types.description: Removes the trailing colon from a compound statement header (if, for, while, def, class, else, elif, try, except).

error_types.name: Unmatched Bracket/Parenthesis
error_types.description: Removes a closing bracket, parenthesis, or brace, leaving it unmatched.

error_types.name: Inconsistent/Bad Indentation
error_types.description: Removes or corrupts the indentation of a line inside a block, breaking Python's block structure.

error_types.name: Missing Parenthesis in Function Call
error_types.description: Converts a valid function call into Python-2-style syntax by removing the parentheses.

error_types.name: Unterminated String Literal
error_types.description: Removes the closing quote of a string literal.

error_types.name: Invalid/Malformed Operator
error_types.description: Inserts an invalid operator combination (e.g. '+*') into an arithmetic expression.

error_types.name: Missing Assignment Operator
error_types.description: Removes the '=' from an assignment statement.

error_types.name: Extra Unmatched Closing Bracket
error_types.description: Adds an extra, unmatched closing bracket/parenthesis at the end of a line.
